heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in the State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 14070636:5002.Oct. 23, 1992, Pub. L. 102–484, title XVIII, § 1802, 106 Stat. 2581. The words “and subject to the laws of such State” are omitted as unnecessary.
